Career Opportunity
Technology Research Analyst – Job Overview  


We are looking for a driven and intellectually curious Technology Research Analyst to join our fast‑paced research team. This role involves conducting comprehensive analysis on companies within the semiconductor and/or power infrastructure sectors, producing high‑quality research publications, and delivering insights to institutional clients and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities  
• Produce detailed, timely research reports covering the semiconductor and/or power infrastructure industries, including company‑specific analyses on firms listed in the United States, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Japan.
• Participate in analyst roadshows and client meetings to present research themes, investment perspectives, and secure client votes.
• Support senior team members with ad‑hoc research assignments and special analytical projects.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporates across the semiconductor and power infrastructure ecosystem.

Requirements  
• Master's degree or above in Finance, Economics, Business, Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• At least 3 years of relevant experience in sell‑side or buy‑side equity research within TMT, semiconductor, power infrastructure, or industrial technology sectors. Experience in a major technology company or power/utility organisation is highly advantageous.
• Excellent command of Putonghua (spoken and written) is essential. English must be used confidently as a daily working language.
• Eligibility to hold a Hong Kong Type 4 (Securities Advisory) licence.
